mentions.name: NexsOS1
mentions.description: An open-source operating system in development for six months that runs on aarch64 and amd64 in graphical mode. It has a separate kernel and userland loaded via ELF, a custom API with a rebuilt libc and POSIX compatibility, and ships applications including a shell, a 3D demo, the kilo text editor, and Doom. Ongoing work includes sandboxing, moving drivers to userland services, and a compositor with multiple resolutions, themes, and variable styles.
